description: This file contains multiple Orleans grain classes used for testing activation garbage collection behavior, including idle, busy, collection-specific age limit, and stateless worker grains.

classes.name: IdleActivationGcTestGrain1
classes.description: A simple idle activation grain implementing IIdleActivationGcTestGrain1.

classes.name: IdleActivationGcTestGrain2
classes.description: Another simple idle activation grain implementing IIdleActivationGcTestGrain2.

classes.name: BusyActivationGcTestGrain1
classes.description: A busy activation grain implementing IBusyActivationGcTestGrain1, holding an ID and references to activation collector and grain context.

classes.name: BusyActivationGcTestGrain2
classes.description: A simple busy activation grain implementing IBusyActivationGcTestGrain2.

classes.name: CollectionSpecificAgeLimitForTenSecondsActivationGcTestGrain
classes.description: An activation grain with a specific age limit of ten seconds, implementing its interface.

classes.name: CollectionSpecificAgeLimitForZeroSecondsActivationGcTestGrain
classes.description: An activation grain with zero seconds age limit, used for testing collection behavior.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerActivationCollectorTestGrain1
classes.description: A stateless worker grain with an ID, implementing IStatelessWorkerActivationCollectorTestGrain1.

methods.name: Nop
methods.description: A method that completes immediately, doing nothing.

methods.name: Delay
methods.description: A method that asynchronously delays for the specified TimeSpan.

methods.name: IdentifyActivation
methods.description: Returns a string identifier for the activation, usually a GUID.
